serviceName: Niftrip advisor website and email (Cloudflare DNS)
description: For domains on Cloudflare DNS. Points www and the bare domain at the advisor's Niftrip website (Cloudflare flattens the bare-domain CNAME), and sets up the domain's email on Niftrip's Google Workspace: Google verification, MX, Google in SPF, a DKIM key Niftrip publishes, and a DMARC record when the domain has none. Each part is its own group so only the parts the advisor chose are applied.
variableDescription: gsv: the Google Site Verification token for this domain (the part after google-site-verification=); dkimid: Niftrip's id for this domain's DKIM key, published by Niftrip at <dkimid>.dkim.niftrip.com; dkimkey: the base64 public key Google Admin shows (only for the dkimtxt group, used if the CNAME form is refused)
